programs.title: Seeta Aur Geeta
programs.desc: Seeta (Hema Malini) is an unhappy heiress who is mistreated by her aunt, Kaushalya (Manorama), who holds the purse strings in the household even though her wealth comes from Seeta's late parents. Despondent, Seeta runs off to end her life, but is rescued and mistaken for her lost twin sister, Geeta (also Malini), who grew up poor and became a tough-minded street performer. The two switch places, surprising those around them by their drastically changed temperaments.

programs.title: Bandit Queen
programs.desc: One of six children from a poor family, she was married at the age of 11, to a man who gave her parents a cow, and threw in a bicycle. Torn weeping from her mother's arms, she was used by her husband as a beast of burden, and taunted by the higher castes of the village where she now lived.

programs.title: Zameer
programs.desc: Maharaj Singh is a proud owner of several derby-winning stallions. One day dacoits attack his farmhouse with a view of stealing these stallions, but Maharaj fights them, killing the son of the leader.

programs.title: Shalimar
programs.desc: Kumar, a thief, aspires to be mafia boss Sir John's successor by stealing Shalimar, a priceless diamond. Adamant to succeed in his mission, Kumar must overcome many tribulations to seize the diamond.
